Request record: pause of weekly check-ins

Status: decided - pause approved.

The member asked to pause weekly check-ins for the month of the spring planning break. The steward looked at the request on the eleventh and held off deciding until the next monthly review, as the member's goals for that month were still being set. Until then, weekly check-ins carry on as normal.
